title: Shulvajirani Vati
description: Shulvajirani Vati (Shulvajrini Vati) is a targeted formulation meant to "conquer colic or sharp pain" through its powerful antispasmodic and analgesic action. This classical tablet relieves severe intestinal cramps where the intestinal muscles contract excessively, causing sharp pain. Gallstone colic, the severe pain caused by gallstones moving through the bile ducts, responds to this formulation's pain-relieving action. Sudden muscular contractions of the stomach from various causes are rapidly soothed. The warm water provides additional antispasmodic support.
dosage: 1 tablet mixed with warm water as soon as symptoms occur
